title: Will She Land on Step 5? A Coin-Flip Staircase | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
Pia climbs a staircase one or two steps at a time, flipping a coin before each move. What is the chance she stands on step 5? Vantee lists every way to get there, shows a faster ladder that builds each step's chance from the two before it, explains why each wrong answer is tempting, and gives you step 6 to try yourself.
